# YeneSchool

> YeneSchool is a school management system for Ethiopian schools. It provides role-based workspaces for admin, teacher, parent, registrar, finance, student, and IT roles — covering admissions, attendance, marks, report cards, exams, finance, communication, and parent portals.

The platform supports the Ethiopian calendar, multiple languages, offline attendance, and an autonomous AI Director engine. It is built for Grade 1-8 and Grade 1-12 schools and serves as a multi-tenant, role-based SaaS.

## Optional

- [Pricing](https://www.yeneschool.me/#pricing): All features included across all plans. Tiered by student capacity: Starter (up to 300 students, 25,000 ETB/mo), Growth (301-1,200 students, 45,000 ETB/mo), Standard (1,201-2,500 students, 70,000 ETB/mo), and Enterprise & Multi-Campus (Custom pricing for 2,500+ students or multiple branches).
